hints: Resolve the four coplanar forces along horizontal and vertical axes.
Set the sum of horizontal components to zero: $18\cos 65^\circ - 12\cos 75^\circ - P\cos\theta = 0$, giving an expression for $P\cos\theta$.
Set the sum of vertical components to zero: $18\sin 65^\circ + 12\sin 75^\circ - 15 - P\sin\theta = 0$, giving an expression for $P\sin\theta$.
Divide $P\sin\theta$ by $P\cos\theta$ to find $\tan\theta$ and $\theta$, then calculate $P = \sqrt{(P\cos\theta)^2 + (P\sin\theta)^2}$.
walkthrough:
Resolve forces horizontally in equilibrium:
$$18\cos 65^\circ - 12\cos 75^\circ - P\cos\theta = 0 \implies P\cos\theta = 18\cos 65^\circ - 12\cos 75^\circ$$

Resolve forces vertically in equilibrium:
$$18\sin 65^\circ + 12\sin 75^\circ - 15 - P\sin\theta = 0 \implies P\sin\theta = 18\sin 65^\circ + 12\sin 75^\circ - 15$$

Find the angle $\theta$ by dividing the vertical equation by the horizontal equation:
$$\tan\theta = \frac{P\sin\theta}{P\cos\theta} = \frac{12.9046}{4.5013} \approx 2.86686 \implies \theta = \arctan(2.86686) \approx 70.8^\circ$$

Calculate the magnitude $P$ using Pythagoras' theorem:
$$P = \sqrt{(4.5013)^2 + (12.9046)^2} = \sqrt{20.2617 + 166.5287} = \sqrt{186.7904} \approx 13.7\text{ N}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
For a system of coplanar forces in equilibrium, the resultant force along any two perpendicular directions must be zero:
$$\sum F_x = 0, \quad \sum F_y = 0$$
Choose horizontal ($+x$ to the right) and vertical ($+y$ upwards) directions.

Sum the horizontal components of the forces:
$$18\cos 65^\circ - 12\cos 75^\circ - P\cos\theta = 0$$
$$P\cos\theta = 18\cos 65^\circ - 12\cos 75^\circ$$

Substitute the trigonometric values $\cos 65^\circ \approx 0.422618$ and $\cos 75^\circ \approx 0.258819$:
$$P\cos\theta = 18(0.422618) - 12(0.258819) = 7.6071 - 3.1058 = 4.5013\text{ N}$$

Sum the vertical components of the forces:
$$18\sin 65^\circ + 12\sin 75^\circ - 15 - P\sin\theta = 0$$
$$P\sin\theta = 18\sin 65^\circ + 12\sin 75^\circ - 15$$

Divide the vertical component by the horizontal component to eliminate $P$ and find $\theta$:
$$\tan\theta = \frac{P\sin\theta}{P\cos\theta} = \frac{12.9046}{4.5013} \approx 2.86686$$
$$\theta = \arctan(2.86686) \approx 70.77^\circ \approx 70.8^\circ$$

Square and add both component equations to find $P^2$:
$$P^2 = (P\cos\theta)^2 + (P\sin\theta)^2 = (4.5013)^2 + (12.9046)^2$$
$$P^2 = 20.2617 + 166.5287 = 186.7904$$
$$P = \sqrt{186.7904} \approx 13.667 \approx 13.7\text{ N}$$
